content.answer: The gap between the two is exactly what the data is measuring.

figures.label: Skills Demand Gap
figures.source: AI/ML roles carry more than 290,000 open postings in India with a demand-supply gap of around 51%, according to NASSCOM data.
figures.text: AI/ML roles carry more than 290,000 open postings in India with a demand-supply gap of around 51%, according to NASSCOM data.

figures.label: Skills Demand Gap
figures.source: Across cloud computing, cybersecurity, data science, DevOps, and full-stack development, NASSCOM reports demand-supply gaps in the 60-73% range.
figures.text: Across cloud computing, cybersecurity, data science, DevOps, and full-stack development, NASSCOM reports demand-supply gaps in the 60-73% range.

figures.label: Graduate Employability Rate
figures.source: Management graduates report the highest employability at 78%, followed by engineering at 71.5% and MCA at 71%, with science graduates lower at 58%.
figures.text: Management graduates report the highest employability at 78%, followed by engineering at 71.5% and MCA at 71%, with science graduates lower at 58%.
